title: Fence sign specifications.
officialText:
Fence signs shall be constructed of ¾-inch (19 mm) plywood or material of equivalent
strength, durability and weatherproofing, including but not limited to sheet metal, aluminum, vinyl, or plastic. The letters on
such signs shall be black on a white background. Such signs shall be no larger than that needed to accommodate the
information required by Section 3301.9.3.1 in letters no less than 3 inches (76 mm) high.
